transcription:
L1 | 3. Kisar nilai 60 sampai 100 (termasuk 60) adalah 41 dan total murid ada 42.
L2 | Bila kita buat kisar nilai adalah him. B dan jumlah murid adalah him. A:
L3 | A (42 siswa) -> B (60-100)
L4 | Maka sifat yg paling mungkin terjadi adalah "Fungsi biasa dan fungsi injektif"
reasoning: Counts 41 possible scores and 42 students, but concludes the function can be injective, which is impossible by pigeonhole; the possible property is surjective.
Only the savings step 150.000 x 1/3 is started (and miscalculated); the book purchase and the split between 2 siblings (Rp30.000) are never done.
The '4 years ago' condition is ignored and today's ages are set to sum to 48, giving mother 36 + 5 = 41 instead of (3x - 4) + (x - 4) = 48, x = 14, 42 + 5 = 47.
3^x = 1/27 is never solved as 3^x = 3^-3 (x = -3); instead numbers are guessed and divided (24 : 5 = 4,8) and plugged back nonsensically, so 5^0 = 1 is not reached.
